3.name: War Domain Spells
3.notes: You always have the listed spells prepared at the appropriate Cleric levels. See spell_table.

3.name: War Priest
3.notes: As a Bonus Action, make one weapon attack or Unarmed Strike. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). All expended uses are regained on a Short or Long Rest.

3.name: Guided Strike
3.notes: When you or a creature within 30 feet misses an attack roll, expend Channel Divinity to give the roll a +10 bonus. If benefiting another creature, you also take a Reaction.

6.name: War God's Blessing
6.notes: Expend Channel Divinity to cast Shield of Faith or Spiritual Weapon without a spell slot. The spell requires no Concentration and lasts 1 minute. It ends early if you cast the spell again, become Incapacitated, or die.

17.name: Avatar of Battle
17.notes: You have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
